locations.note: Physics student Darren Michaels works in a run-down photo studio in Biddeford, Maine, where the story starts.
Darren follows the kidnapped Angelina to Willow Creek, the village of the first game, and his trail ends at the Gordons' manor Black Mirror, where the family curse waits.

routes.name: Darren Michaels
routes.note: From a seedy photo shop in Biddeford across the Atlantic to Willow Creek, where Darren's trail ends at the Gordons' cursed manor.
